evidence: Name and slug: task.toml line 5 has name = "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools"; the source directory is projects/colderwater-playground-devtools and diff -rq between it and the frozen snapshot reports no difference, so [task].name equals turing/<dirname> (three hyphen tokens). The golden's package.json name is the same slug. No template placeholder remains: every CHANGE_ME field of the template task.toml ([task].name, description, first keyword, difficulty, difficulty_explanation, category, provenance, arena_slice) is filled, and every other task.toml line is byte-for-byte the template's. Description: "A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions." Each axis is a public requirement of this task: overview.md "formatting, selection, multiple carets and undo", ui.md "Build the code editing surface with your own DOM, canvas or SVG text model", security.md "User-entered code runs in an isolated browser preview", behaviour.md revision history and restore. It quotes no criterion count that could go stale. Keywords [webdev, turing, full-stack, custom-editor, javascript, html, formatting, code-playground, devtools] match: .js/.html execution modes, SQLite-backed server (integration.md), custom editor, Format. difficulty = "hard" with difficulty_explanation "custom code editor with selection, multi-caret undo and formatting, then integrating its exact source with isolated execution and revision-safe saving" describes the same axes (stale-save conflict in behaviour.md). category = "programming" (used by 10 sibling tasks), provenance = "Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task.", arena_slice = "custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history" all describe this task. Product name is spelled consistently as Colderwater in provenance, tests/app_context.md ("Name: Colderwater playground"), all five judge prompts ("Evaluate the live Colderwater playground") and the golden title; no leftover name of another product (grep for coldwater-without-er inside the task finds nothing; the 'coldwater' spelling appears only in QC run ids and run-outputs outside the task). seed_data.json note ("JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history") agrees. Minor observations, not defects: the description describes but does not literally contain the name Colderwater, and the public brief never names the product either, which is harmless because no criterion grades the product name; the 'devtools' slug/keyword token is supported only loosely by the console/inspect-the-result surface. Broken-app / conforming-alternative probe: identity fields are not graded, so no app can pass or fail on them; a conforming app with a different visible title is not penalised by any identity field. Raw evidence index hashes were recomputed (22 of 22 match); that evidence is not needed for this metadata row, and no runtime, Oracle or portal result is claimed here.
